transcript.content: Hello, I’m Dr. ChatGPT. What brings you in today?
I'm visiting today because I've been feeling constantly worried and extremely exhausted for over a year now. It's really starting to take a toll on me, and I just can't seem to get my energy back.
Have you also been feeling down or losing interest or pleasure in things most days during this time?
No, I haven't really been feeling down or losing interest in my usual activities. My main struggle is just this constant, uncontrollable worry and feeling extremely exhausted all the time.
Do you find it hard to control the worry, and do you also have symptoms like restlessness, muscle tension, irritability, trouble concentrating, or sleep problems?

Yes, once my worrying starts, I find it almost impossible to stop or control. It drains me mentally and makes it very hard to concentrate when I'm trying to think, but I don't really experience restlessness, muscle tension, irritability, or sleep issues.
